codeReview.summary: Commit 439c1dba fulfills the feature contract. It reduces `theme-factory.ts` from a 226-line mixed-responsibility module to a 66-line entry point, moves defaults, color conversion, and type declarations into focused helpers that all stay under the 200-line mission target, and preserves the existing `createTheme`, `createHighContrastTheme`, `hexToRgbTriplet`, and type exports used by the theme catalog and high-contrast helper. The extracted logic is byte-for-byte equivalent in behavior to the pre-split implementation, so the reviewed change preserves the already-verified theme behavior and does not introduce new bundle-expanding logic in scope.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared guidance still leaves an ambiguity between repo-standards size checks and the mission's stricter 200-line refactor target. Workers need an explicit reminder that `npm run check:repo-standards` is not sufficient evidence for the 200-line goal and must be paired with direct `wc -l` checks on all affected modules.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The feature contract requires `wc -l` confirmation for split modules, and this review confirmed the worker had to record separate counts for `theme-factory.ts` (66 lines), `theme-factory-defaults.ts` (117), `theme-factory-color.ts` (18), and `theme-factory-types.ts` (43). The existing review file and handoff note that repo-standards passed only for changed files, while `.factory/library/extension-core-notes.md` documents a different default size threshold.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The refactor-worker skill assumes mission metadata lives under a repo-local `.factory/missions/...` path, but this mission supplied its canonical metadata from an external mission directory. The worker handled it correctly, yet the skill should document that reviewers/workers must use the missionDir path provided by the orchestrator when the repo-local mirror is absent.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The transcript and handoff for worker session `bb97595b-9b95-45d9-8ab6-54a438b480c8` read mission files from `/Users/sero/.factory/missions/2de43d43-4917-4fd5-8d4a-9155693b51d8/...`, and `handoff.skillFeedback.suggestedChanges` explicitly calls out the missing repo-local mission path expectation.

summary: Pass. The split keeps the theme factory API and behavior intact, meets the under-200-line module target for all extracted files, and surfaces two non-blocking shared-state guidance gaps around size-limit validation and external mission metadata paths.
